{{Vanilla|Charcoal}}
{{Infobox auto}}
'''Charcoal''' is a fuel made by burning logs. In [[Matcha Flavoured]] it is made in an [[oven]] or [[Mud Kiln|mud kiln]], and logs mined with the adamant tool intrinsic drop it directly.

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}
Any log or wood cooked in an oven or mud kiln becomes charcoal.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/kiln/charcoal.json}}</ref> Logs broken with a tool with the [[Adamant equipment|adamant]] tool intrinsic drop charcoal, increased by Fortune.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/oak_log.json}}</ref>

=== Other sources ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==
{{Uses}}
Charcoal fuels furnaces and makes 8 [[torch]]es with a stick. Two coal or charcoal make 4 black [[Dyes|dye]], and it is used in fire charges.
